name: repo-graph
description: Share a repo with Claude and get its code-structure graph (folders, files, classes, functions, API endpoints, calls, imports, tests) plus its AI agents, MCP servers, services and env vars as an interactive view, and reviews PRs, branches and uncommitted work by what they did to that structure. Works on install with no server: Claude runs the bundled graph builder itself. Graph only, no LLM summaries or embeddings, so it takes seconds.
